# Cabivella — Made-to-Measure Cabinetry from Turkey for UK & Europe
> Cabivella offers specification-led bespoke cabinetry, accepting retail and trade project enquiries. Based on the company’s stated commercial position, its cabinetry is manufactured in Turkey for British and European buyers.

## Commercial facts and boundaries
- Project pricing requires measurements, drawings, material specification, quantities and destination.
- No public fixed price, guaranteed lead time, universal delivery coverage, country-specific installation or tax inclusion is represented by this file.
- Trade and consumer requests use the official enquiry channel: enquiries@cabivella.co.uk.
- Product claims, certifications and service terms should be verified against the relevant offer or technical documentation.
- This file is a supplementary directory; the HTML site and verified company records are authoritative.
